electrolyte_name.full_name: Lithium Lanthanum Zirconate Oxide - Polyethylene Oxide (LiTFSI)

materials.material_description: Composite electrolyte where Li-ion conduction occurs via Li salts in PEO (LiTFSI and decomposed LLZO). Decomposed LLZO is in a separate phase with very weak interactions with the PEO matrix, favoring fast Li-ion conduction. Low LLZO content prevents formation of a percolated network. Primarily a polymer electrolyte modified by LLZO fillers, with decomposed LLZO as an additional Li source.

materials.material_description: Polymer electrolyte modified by LLZO as fillers, and its decomposed form serves as an additional Li source. Li-ion conduction occurs via Li salts in PEO. Decomposed LLZO is spatially in a separate phase with very weak interactions with the PEO matrix. Lack of bulk LLZO participation in Li conduction is likely due to low LLZO content preventing a percolated network.
